def check_pair(pair):
    I_,O_=G[pair+' input'],G[pair+' output']
    H,W=len(I_),len(I_[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for row in I_ for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=components(I_,bg)
    tmpls=[(c,o) for c,o in comps if len(o)>1]; dots=[(c,o) for c,o in comps if len(o)==1]
    reports=[]
    for dc,do in dots:
        dpos=next(iter(do))
        found=False
        for tc,to in tmpls:
            dmin=min(max(abs(r-dpos[0]),abs(c-dpos[1])) for r,c in to)
            if dmin>2: continue
            rs=[r for r,_ in to]; cs=[c for _,c in to]
            rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            vert = dpos[0]<rmin or dpos[0]>rmax
            horz = dpos[1]<cmin or dpos[1]>cmax
            if not (vert or horz): continue
            sx=(dpos[1]-cmin-1) if dpos[1]<cmin else (dpos[1]-cmax+1)
            sy=(dpos[0]-rmin-1) if dpos[0]<rmin else (dpos[0]-rmax+1)
            cp={(r+sy,c+sx) for r,c in to}
            if not all(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W for r,c in cp): continue
            if dpos in cp: continue
            if any(I_[r][c]!=bg for r,c in cp): continue
            pred={(r,c,O_[r][c]) for r,c in cp}
            actual={(r,c,O_[r][c]) for r,c in cp if I_[r][c]==bg}
            if pred==actual:
                reports.append(('dot%d'%dc,'tmpl %d n=%d'%(tc,len(to)),'shift',(sy,sx),'OK'))
                found=True; break
            else:
                print('  dot%ds%d tmpl%ds%d shift(%d,%d) MISMATCH' %(dc,dpos[0],tc,len(to),sy,sx))
        if not found: reports.append(('dot%ds%d UNEXPLAINED'%(dc,dpos[0])))
    return reports
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 5']:
    print(p, check_pair(p))

import collections, json
def components(grid,bg):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j));cells=[];col=grid[i][j]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop();cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and grid[a][b]==col and (a,b) not in seen:
                            seen.add((a,b));st.append((a,b))
                out.append((col,frozenset(cells)))
    return out

def reflect(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=components(g,bg)
    tmpls=[o for c,o in comps if len(o)>1]
    dots=[next(iter(o)) for c,o in comps if len(o)==1]
    # map each dot to nearest template (min chebyshev dist to any template cell); tie -> nearest first found
    for dpos in dots:
        best=min(((min(max(abs(r-dpos[0]),abs(c-dpos[1])) for r,c in t),t,i) for i,t in enumerate(tmpls)))
        _,tmplset,idx=best
        rs=[r for r,_ in tmplset]; cs=[c for _,c in tmplset]
        rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        vert = dpos[0]<rmin or dpos[0]>rmax
        horz = dpos[1]<cmin or dpos[1]>cmax
        a = rmin-1 if (vert and dpos[0]<rmin) else (rmax+1 if vert else None)
        b = cmin-1 if (horz and dpos[1]<cmin) else (cmax+1 if horz else None)
        cp={(2*a-r if a is not None else r, 2*b-c if b is not None else c) for r,c in tmplset}

        for r,c in cp:

def analyze(n):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    # bg = most common color
    import collections
    cnt=collections.Counter(p for r in I for p in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_bg(I,bg)
    tmpl=[c for c in cs if len(c)>1]; seeds=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    print('pair',n,'bg',bg,'ntmpl',len(tmpl),'nseed',len(seeds))
    for t in tmpl:
        rs=[p[0] for p in t]; cc=[p[1] for p in t]
        print('  tmpl size',len(t),'cols',{I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in t},'bbox',(min(rs),min(cc),max(rs),max(cc)))
    # diff = output!=input, restricted to bg cells in input
    dd=[(i,j,O[i][j],I[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
    print('  ndiff',len(dd), sorted({d[2] for d in dd}))
analyze(2)

from collections import Counter
def mono_comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=8 and (i,j) not in seen:
                # mono comp search: BFS over same color
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]; seen.add((i,j))
                while st:
                    p=st.pop(); comp.append(p)
                    for a,b in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=p[0]+a,p[1]+b
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
                out.append((col,comp))
    return out
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    comps=mono_comps(g)
    tmpl=max(comps,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))  # largest mono comp = template
    tc=tmpl[0]; tset=set(tmpl[1])
    seeds=[(c,cp[0]) for c,cp in comps if len(cp)==1 and cp!=tmpl[1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for scol,spt in seeds:
        # nearest template cell by manhattan
        best=min(tset,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-spt[0])+abs(p[1]-spt[1]))
        dr=best[0]-spt[0]; dc=best[1]-spt[1]
        pts=set()
        for (r,c) in tset:
            nr,nc=r,c
            if dr!=0 and dc==0: nr=2*best[0]-r
            if dc!=0 and dr==0: nc=2*best[1]-c
            if dr!=0 and dc!=0: nr,nc=2*best[0]-r,2*best[1]-c
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: pts.add((nr,nc))
        for (r,c) in pts: out[r][c]=scol
    return out
ok=True
for n in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    m=f(I)==O
    ok&=m
    print(n,m)
print('ALL',ok)

import itertools
def dihed_trans(pts):
    res=[]
    for fliph in (False,True):
        p=[(r,-c if fliph else c) for r,c in pts]
        for rot in range(4):
            q=[(c,-r) for r,c in p]
            if rot==0: qq=q
            elif rot==1: qq=[(-c,r) for r,c in q]
            elif rot==2: qq=[(-r,-c) for r,c in q]
            else: qq=[(c,-r) for r,c in q]
            res.append(tuple(sorted(qq)))
    # dedupe by canonical form
    out={}
    for s in res:
        m=min((r,c) for r,c in s)
        norm=tuple(sorted((r-m[0],c-m[1]) for r,c in s))
        out[norm]=None
    return list(out)

def f(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    comps=mono_comps(I)
    tcol,tmpl=max(comps,key=lambda c:len(c[1]))
    tset=set(tmpl); res=[row[:] for row in I]
    for scol,comp in comps:
        if len(comp)==1:
            si,sj=comp[0]
            tr,tc=min(tset,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-si)+abs(p[1]-sj))
            pts=set()
            for r,c in tset:
                nr=r if (r-tr)<0 and (si< tc or not (tr<si<tr+2)) else (2*tr-r if False else r)  # placeholder
                # vertical flip iff seed is strictly above/below template's row span
                nr = r if (min(r for r,c in tset)<=si<=max(r for r,c in tset)) else 2*tr-r
                nc = c if (min(c for r,c in tset)<=sj<=max(c for r,c in tset)) else 2*tc-c
                if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: pts.add((nr,nc))
            for r,c in pts: res[r][c]=scol
    return res

def f(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    comps=mono_comps(I)
    tcol,tmpl=max(comps,key=lambda c:len(c[1]))
    tset=set(tmpl); res=[row[:] for row in I]
    rmin,rmax=min(r for r,c in tset),max(r for r,c in tset)
    cmin,cmax=min(c for r,c in tset),max(c for r,c in tset)
    for scol,comp in comps:
        if len(comp)!=1: continue
        si,sj=comp[0]
        # nearest template cell by diagonal distance, tie-break manhattan
        best=min(tset,key=lambda p:(max(abs(p[0]-si),abs(p[1]-sj)),abs(p[0]-si)+abs(p[1]-sj)))
        pts=set()
        for r,c in tset:
            nr=r if (rmin<=si<=rmax) else 2*best[0]-r
            nc=c if (cmin<=sj<=cmax) else 2*best[1]-c
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: pts.add((nr,nc))
        for r,c in pts: res[r][c]=scol
    return res

def fit(n,col=None):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=max(set(p for r in I for p in r),key=lambda q:sum(r.count(q) for r in I))
    comps=mono_comps(I,bg)
    tcol,tmpl=max(comps,key=lambda c:len(c[1]))
    tset=set(tmpl)
    res=[]
    for scol,comp in comps:
        if len(comp)!=1: continue

import os,re

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def dih(P):
    # dihedral group of normalized point sets: return set of 8 variants as sorted tuples
    pts=list(P)
    outs=[]
    for flip in (False,True):
        q=[(r,c) if not flip else (r,-c) for r,c in pts]
        for rot in range(4):
            s=q
            if rot==1: s=[(-c,r) for r,c in q]
            elif rot==2: s=[(-r,-c) for r,c in q]
            elif rot==3: s=[(c,-r) for r,c in q]
            mn=min(s)
            outs.append(tuple(sorted((r-mn[0],c-mn[1]) for r,c in s)))
    uniq=set(outs)
    return [t for t in uniq]
def find_placement(tset, A):
    # A: set of target cells; find (transform, translation) with T+offset == A exactly
    res=[]
    for Ti in dih(tset):

        shifted={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in Ti}
        if shifted==A:
            res.append((Ti,(dr,dc)))
    return res
